package usecase

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/domain"
)

type StepMaterializationDTO struct {
	Schema         string              `json:"schema"`
	TaskInstanceID string              `json:"task_instance_id"`
	TaskRevisionID string              `json:"task_revision_id"`
	StepID         string              `json:"step_id"`
	Title          string              `json:"title"`
	Objective      string              `json:"objective"`
	Deliverables   []string            `json:"deliverables"`
	Acceptance     []domain.Acceptance `json:"acceptance"`
}

type MaterializationResult struct {
	Value    StepMaterializationDTO
	Replayed bool
}

func projectStepMaterialization(instance domain.TaskInstance, step domain.Step) (StepMaterializationDTO, error) {
	if step.Title == "" || step.Objective == "" {
		return StepMaterializationDTO{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: materialization title and objective are required", domain.ErrAuthoringDefect)
	}
	value := StepMaterializationDTO{Schema: "practice-task-step-materialization.v2",
		TaskInstanceID: instance.ID, TaskRevisionID: instance.TaskRevisionID, StepID: step.ID,
		Title: step.Title, Objective: step.Objective, Deliverables: step.Deliverables, Acceptance: step.Acceptance}
	return value, nil
}
